page.layout: One printed page: running text in one column with a Latin inscription set in capitals, a line-number column at the right edge of the text, marginal notes in the left margin, a copper-engraved map titled DE BISCAIA in the middle lower part, and a paragraph with a large initial below the map. Notes left margin: "Hispan. Divisio in Superiorem Inferiorem suspecta.", "Hispania Major Minor.", "Hodierna Hispaniae Partitio.", "Biscaia."

main_text.l: Marianus Scotus, Auctor Notitiæ Provinciarum, Baleares addit Insulas: Sub dispositio-
ne, inquit, Viri spectabilis Vicarij Hispaniarum, Consulares Baticæ, Lusitaniæ, Galliciæ;

l.i: Præsidiales, Tarraconensis, Karthaginiensis, Tingitaniæ, Insularum Balearium.

main_text.l: Videtur & aliquando divisa fuisse Hispania in Superiorem & Inferiorem; quum
hujus fiat mentio in tabula Marmorea antiqui Sepulchri, quæ in Agro Tiburtino,
subque ipso Tibure, ad Pontem Lucanum; sic de Ti. Plautio Silvano inter alia ho-
norifice loquens:

nisi vitiose Sculptor (nam his talibus non, quantam nonnulli volunt, fides semper
est adhibenda) vocem IN geminarit.
In Majorem etiam & Minorem partitur Stephanus. Alias quæ Gothorum te-
mporibus institutæ, Divisiones, brevitatis gratia, omitto. Videndi Io. Gerundensis
Episcop. Paralipomenon Hispaniæ lib. 1. & alij Rerum Hispanicarum Auctores.
Hodie in multa Regna, multosque Principatus distribuitur. Quæ enim Cite-
rior olim, & Tarraconensis postea Romanis, nunc alia est, ad Iberi ripam Borealem,
alia ad Africanam. Ad Borealem quidem in Ultramontanis sunt Biscaia & Guipuscoa,
in Cismontanis autem cis Cingam Navarra & Aragonia, trans Cingam Catalonia.
Africana vel est Cis-Tagana vel Trans-Tagana: Illa in Durij ripa dextra versus Oc-
cidentem habet Galliciam, versus Ortum Austriam & Legionem; in sinistra Castiliam &
Veterem & Novam. Trans-Taganæ adcensentur Volentia & Murcia. Quæ Ulterioris
Baticæ quondam Romanis, comprehendit hodie trans Bætim Granadam & Andaluziam,
cis Bætim Extremaduram. Lusitania Romanorum hodie fere Portugallia dici-
tur. Harum omnium Partium, quo ordine methodoque commemoravi, delineatio-
nem, quam potero fidelissime, proponam. Offert se primo loco Bis-
caia.

page.notes: The engraved map is described only, not transcribed; its place names are not legible enough to copy. Large initial B in BISCAIA. Printed line numbers 10, 20, 30 stand in the right margin beside the text. Passage of the Latin inscription is set in small capitals and is transcribed as read; some letters are uncertain. Last line of the page continues with the word "rum" at the right.
